context_requirements: Neuronal or glial lineage for I2 imidazoline receptor-mediated signalling; none of the nine lines are neuronal
MAO-A/MAO-B expression is ubiquitous but inhibition of these enzymes does not acutely change transcription of the 978 landmark genes
No adrenergic/imidazoline receptor-linked transcriptional programme is measurable in these cancer lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Selective induction of MAO-A/MAO-B target genes or monoamine-metabolism genes
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent with vehicle

evidence.supports: I2 imidazoline receptor ligands act as neuroprotective agents in AD mouse models; effects are behavioural and pathological rather than acute transcriptional, and were studied in brain, not cancer cell lines
